description: This file declares the interface IAuthenticator with virtual methods for authentication-related operations, including validate, updatePubKey, isStillValid, and resolvePermissions, used in the Kuksa project.

classes.name: IAuthenticator
classes.description: An interface defining authentication operations for Kuksa channels, including validation, permission resolution, and key management.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the given KuksaChannel using the provided authentication token.

methods.name: updatePubKey
methods.description: Updates the public key used for authentication.

methods.name: isStillValid
methods.description: Checks if the channel's authentication is still valid.

methods.name: resolvePermissions
methods.description: Resolves permissions associated with the KuksaChannel.
